schedule_id.meaning: Schedule id; HTTP reads schedule_id and the CLI uses its positional id.

calendar.meaning: If calendar is an object its fields are used; otherwise the patch itself supplies calendar fields.

time.meaning: Local time in HH:MM; at is its fallback.

weekday.meaning: The daily calendar ignores this value of any JSON type. Weekly requires Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, or Sun. weekday takes precedence over day when present.

day.meaning: The daily calendar ignores this value of any JSON type. Weekly requires Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, or Sun. This is the fallback only when weekday is absent.

enabled.meaning: Optional enabled state when the top-level enabled field is absent; null preserves the prior state and a malformed present value is treated as false.
Optional enabled state; null or missing preserves the prior state and a non-boolean present value is treated as false.

readback.meaning: Status view after the operation, including schedule, next_fire, last_fire and baseline.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: <raw SQLite or filesystem error text>, <stored JSON parser error text>, and pid2-invalid-json: <parser message> on HTTP. Also protocol-kernel-field-missing:<field>, protocol-kernel-definition-missing:<index>, and pid2-command-wake-persist-failed: <error>.

first_missing_signal.meaning: HTTP refusal field, identical to firstMissingSignal on that refusal. Open forms are the same HTTP refusal forms described for firstMissingSignal.
